beats.summary: Michael struggles with whether to be honest with Jan about his actions at a bachelor party.

evidence.snippet: Michael: On one hand I want to be honest with Jan and tell her the truth but on the other hand I'm afraid she's going to dump me.
Michael: Not really, look I don't know how to say this so I just will.

beats.summary: Ben Franklin admits to fathering an illegitimate son but kept it secret from his wife.

evidence.snippet: Ben Franklin: You know Michael, I fathered an illegitimate son.
Ben Franklin: But I kept all this from my wife Deborah.

beats.summary: Ben Franklin humorously comments on chocolate and kings during a conversation with Dwight.

evidence.snippet: Ben Franklin: Chocolate! Where did you acquire it? That is a delicacy in the Amazon but it has not yet been imported to the United States.
Ben Franklin: Why the tyrant King George, of course!

beats.summary: Pam flirts with Ben Franklin and discusses her desire for a boyfriend with Ryan.

evidence.snippet: Kelly: Anyway, do you know who was totally flirting with Ben Franklin? Pam.
Pam: Yeah, right. God, I need a boyfriend. You know Ryan I'm totally ready to be set up with one of your business school friends.
